improvements: Adjusted rim/hub geometry so the complete cabin envelope is approximately 53 m, retaining 42 cabins.
Corrected spoke centres so all 42 spokes radiate from the hub.
Replaced solid red gondola cubes with framed glazed white cabins and one dark VIP cabin; the separate ticket office is not claimed as replaced.
remainingGaps: Cabin shape, suspension offsets, A-frame connections and support deck are simplified; the registry wheel remains static.
The tourist waterfront has a separately animated framed-cabin wheel; this study does not verify its ride mechanics or lighting.
These are isolated front/top/oblique model studies, not matched street-eye Street View/aerial comparisons. They do not establish full-world, night, weather or seasonal parity.
Integrated source-only replacement and rebuilt district performance are separate acceptance checks; the capture branch predates that shared world policy.
